messages:
sam_marketing: Heads-up: Uptown Dev Night next Thurs — final booth/runbook. Need approvals on swag qty, speaker slide deck, and QR lead routing. Also want copy for LinkedIn + X scheduled. Who's on last-mile?

anya: I can own swag qty. Current PO says 400 stickers, 200 tees, 50 hoodies. Should we up tees to 300? estimate 350 attendees.

mike_ops: tees -> 300 sounds safe. Shipping cutoff Wed EOD. I booked a courier for display crates arriving Thu AM. Tracking: #CRTR-998.

julia_sales: For lead routing — we should tag leads by interest: demo, pricing, partnership. Can we route demo -> @julia_sales, pricing -> @sam_marketing, partnership -> @ryan_partner? Also need webhook to our CRM.

sam_marketing: Yes. Here's a tiny routing config (workable):
```
route_map:
  demo: sales-demo
  pricing: growth
  partnership: bizdev
```

ops_bot: Courier booked: Pickup Wed 6pm, ETA Thu 8:30am. AWB: AWB123456789.

anya: Order update: increased tees to 300; added 100 sticker sheets for swag bag inserts. Hoodie sizes: S-10, M-20, L-15, XL-5.

mike_ops: Booth staff rota drafted: 10:00-13:00 @anya + @sam; 13:00-16:00 @julia + @ryan; 16:00-19:00 @mike_ops + @emma_dev. Can @sam confirm demo run cadence (10-12min + Q)?

sam_marketing: Confirm demo format: 8-10min live demo + 5min Q. Rotation cadence 12min. We'll hand out slide one-pager. @design can we print 50 one-pagers? also need a 24x36 poster with benchmark headline: 'Redwood: 3x lower cost on standard chat workloads vs baseline' (need sign-off).

emma_dev: Slides from @ryan are in Drive: https://drive.google.com/example. Small ask — ensure we don't promise latency numbers in person without the benchmark slide deck. Use 'up to' phrasing.

julia_sales: For post-event nurturing — capture email + company size + interest. Can we set up auto-drip: Day 0: thank you + recording; Day 3: 1-pager + case study; Day 10: schedule meeting CTA.

sam_marketing: Yep. I'll draft copy for LinkedIn and the event page. Quick versions:
- LinkedIn teaser: 'Catch Redwood at Uptown Dev Night — live demo of low-latency LLM serving + free tees. Stop by booth #A3!' 
- X post: 'Demoing fast LLM inference at Uptown Dev Night. Booth A3. Free stickers.'
Thoughts?

ryan_partner: Tone good. For LinkedIn drop the 'free' maybe — we usually avoid transactional. Suggest: 'Stop by booth A3 to see a live demo and chat about scaling inference.'

anya: :thumbsup: I'll approve swag PO once tees + hoodies counts final.

sam_marketing: Reminder: Speaker submission update — we didn't get accepted for the main talk. We have a lightning slot at 4:20pm. Confirm who will present? @ryan volunteered earlier.

ryan_partner: I can do the lightning 7min. Will prepare a 3-slide micro deck and a single benchmark slide. Need someone for stage handoff.

mike_ops: I'll handle stage handoff and connect laptop. Bring HDMI + dongles + USB-C. Also we should bring battery bank + power strip.

emma_dev: Can we load a demo package offline? Venue wifi flaky. I'll package a docker image and run locally.

sam_marketing: Good call. Also capture lead scanning: QR leads to short form (email, company, interest). Use QR redirect -> shortform.link/upr2026. Test before go-live.

julia_sales: Can we add a hidden field 'source=uptown2026' so CRM tags it?

sam_marketing: Yes. I'll update routing config.
```
utm_source: uptown2026
hidden_field: source=uptown2026
```

ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: Ship crates Wed 18:00 (2 days).

anya: Final asks: who brings table runner and laptop stand? I can bring runner. @mike_ops will bring laptop stand?

mike_ops: Yes.

sam_marketing: Ok team — final checklist: swag PO approved, courier booked, rota set, QR/form & routing in place, LinkedIn copy updated per feedback, lightning talk owner @ryan. I'll push final runbook tomorrow at 10am. Any blockers?

ryan_partner: All good from me. Will rehearse Wed evening.

julia_sales: All good. Adding follow-up sequence in CRM.
